tip: hoşlanmak, to enjoy, needs the ablative -tan on what you enjoy. yapmaktan hoşlanırım means enjoy from doing.
The locative -de marks a timeframe, so otuz günde means within thirty days, not on day thirty.
Aorist plus -di makes a habitual past. çekerdi means used to draw, a repeated action long ago.
zorunda kalmak means to be forced to and follows a plain infinitive. yürümek zorunda kaldı means had to walk.
ne olursa olsun is a fixed phrase for no matter what. Hava ne olursa olsun means whatever the weather.
The suffix -meli means should or must, as in yemeliler, they should eat.
-saydın plus an aorist-past builds an unreal past. çalışsaydın then geçerdin means had you studied, you would have passed.
Possession links two words. Komşunun takes genitive -nun and tavukları takes -ları, the neighbor's chickens.
The frame -se de and -mese de means whether or not. İstesem de istemesem de means whether I want to or not.
-se on a verb makes an open if. öğrensem means if I learn, with the outcome still possible.
-dığım turns a verb into that I did. aldığım çilekler means the strawberries that I bought.
-ken added to a verb means while. gelirken means while coming, marking the background action.
-an makes a who does relative. Karate yapan sporcu means the athlete who does karate, with no separate who word.
Repeating a word intensifies it. taze taze means all fresh or freshly, stressing manner.
